FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Sweet Treats Emporium is a retail candy and confectionery store specializing in a wide range of candies, chocolates, and confections sourced exclusively from licensed and inspected manufacturers. Our operations focus on providing an enjoyable shopping experience for customers, with products displayed in a vibrant and inviting manner. Our store features a selection of packaged candies, bulk bins for self-service, and seasonal offerings to keep our inventory fresh and exciting. 

We prioritize food safety and hygiene, ensuring that all products are stored and handled in compliance with local health regulations, and we maintain current health permits and food handling certifications for our staff. Our self-serve bulk bins are regularly cleaned and monitored for sanitation compliance, minimizing any risk of contamination. Additionally, we emphasize allergen labeling and clear food safety information to assist customers with dietary needs.

Our store does not engage in any high-heat cooking processes or the sale of alcoholic or cannabis-infused products, keeping our operations within safe parameters. This focus not only enhances our safety profile but also fosters a reliable shopping environment for our customers. Sweet Treats Emporium is committed to providing quality products while adhering to regulatory standards and ensuring the satisfaction of our valued customers.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in on-site deep frying or high-heat cooking processes that exceed 20% of our operations and confirms full compliance with all local health department regulations and inspections for food production. Additionally, we do not sell alcoholic or cannabis-infused products, and our bulk self-serve bins are maintained with thorough sanitation controls and regular cleaning schedules.
